author: Biswajit Jana
title: Open Exoplanet Evidence Lab
question: How stable are exoplanet inferences and survey-completeness claims when instrumental zero points, stellar activity, chromatic RV behaviour, temporal sampling, reduction provenance and independent observing modalities are modelled explicitly?

sources.name: NEID Earth Twin Survey III
sources.detail: 41 public survey targets with VizieR RV and activity time-series products.

sources.name: HD 190360 / NETS IV
sources.detail: Public NEID benchmark around the published 88.69 d signal; used for validation, not rediscovery.

sources.name: ESO NIRPS Phase-3
sources.detail: Dynamic public reduced-data stream with explicit DRS provenance and the documented 2025 precision-RV quality gate.

sources.name: ESO HARPS archive
sources.detail: Coordinate-based archive crossmatch and exact epoch-overlap accounting feed the optical/NIR experiment.

sources.name: TESS recent sectors
sources.detail: Sector 106 is a mature control; Sector 107 is treated as a versioned evolving release.

sources.name: JWST/HST Rocky Worlds
sources.detail: Versioned MIRI eclipse products and HST stellar products support visit-to-visit repeatability tests.

sources.name: NASA Atmospheric Spectroscopy
sources.role: Spectral reproducibility and bounded thermal retrieval
sources.detail: Five 55 Cnc e visits and two public reductions support brightness-temperature, BIC and held-out-visit tests; the narrow band and missing covariance explicitly preclude a molecular-abundance claim.

sources.name: SPORES-HWO II
sources.detail: Verified public VizieR tables provide 153,902 raw RV rows for 141 targets; a frozen 26-star control sample tests instrument, null, eccentricity and leave-dominant-instrument assumptions.

sources.name: TESS Stellar Variability Catalog v1.0
sources.role: Independent variability context for HWO targets
sources.detail: Exact SIMBAD-to-TIC links connect SPORES-HWO targets to the 84,046-row MAST catalogue without treating non-matches as quiet-star labels.

sources.name: Gaia DR3 identity registry
sources.role: Canonical source identity and public astrometric context
sources.detail: All 41 NETS III survey targets resolve to distinct exact Gaia DR3 source identifiers; no astrometric field is treated as a companion classification.

sources.name: Gaia DR4
sources.detail: No current result depends on unreleased DR4 products or an assumed final archive schema.

validation.name: Known-signal recovery
validation.meaning: Deterministic tests recover injected circular RV amplitudes, phases and instrument-era offsets.

validation.name: Chromatic consistency
validation.meaning: Synthetic optical/NIR tests recover a known semi-amplitude ratio and phase relationship.

validation.name: Completeness classification
validation.meaning: Recovery logic distinguishes exact periods, accepted harmonics and misses under frozen rules.

validation.name: Atmospheric repeatability
validation.meaning: Random-effects tests return zero extra scatter for statistically consistent repeats and positive scatter for overdispersed repeats.

validation.name: Provenance integrity
validation.meaning: Manifest hashes and file checksums detect both metadata and input-file tampering.

validation.name: Instrument quality gates
validation.meaning: NIRPS precision-RV tests reject the documented affected DRS interval unless corrected processing is verified.
